snippet.title: Assetto Corsa EVO - Official Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
FGS Live From gamescom latam featured a new fast-paced, adrenaline fueled gameplay trailer for Assetto Corsa EVO, the high octane racing simulation from Kunos Simulazioni and 505 Games. The exciting trailer showed off a variety of tracks, driven by supercars and more civilian-looking cars, alike. Out now in Steam Early Access on PC.  

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #gamescomlatam 

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
